GIN.note: Nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.
AI is named only in a health emergency centre, a sector system.

systems.system: Plateforme numerique de suivi des alertes du COU-SP
systems.owner: ANSS / Ministere de la Sante et de l'Hygiene publique

GIN.note: Only a training course on AI tools is stated; no AI tool is said to run in the health system.
No AI model, dataset or AI computing built or hosted in the country is stated.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health and Public Hygiene, through the ANSS with IOM Guinea and US CDC funding, launched a training for several health-sector officials in practical use of AI for document analysis, data, alert tracking and decision support in the public health emergency operations centre.

GIN.note: Training is for health officials, not the public.
